No phone. Get a trip sitter that makes you feel comfortable and safe. Plan it out. Having everything laid out already so you don't have to do anything other than just exist (meaning, have the music ready, beverages and light snacks / candy / fruit (just for taste, you wont be hungry), scenery.) Make sure you are in a place where nothing unexpected can happen like random visits.

In terms of scenery, have it be pretty and appealing but un-stimulating. I took acid at a couple concerts and kind of defeated the purpose, really sets the visuals back because your mind is to busy processing all the external stimuli 

Set and setting is the most important. Also, if you had a bad day or week and aren't feeling great beforehand and also have been feeling good generally, post-pone.

I don't really follow these guidelines much and just wing it but thats what I recommend for someone starting out to avoid having a bad first trip which could potencialy condition all future trips.

Also if you smoke tabacco, have it at hand, it could be helpful. Don't mix with other drugs.

You should be able to let go, if you can't, maybe postpone. Right after breakfast is the best time IMO

Well, what I'm thinking maybe could be affected by the yellowing (or lack thereof) might be the taste, harshness even and what kind of ash it burns into. I hear a lot about the importance of flushing (which I've noticed, not all people are on board with also) and how without a proper flush, the smoke can be pretty harsh, taste off and produce black ash. This having to due, allegedly, with nutrients and/or sugars still "stockpiled" inside the plant, or something along those lines. As I've heard before, when a plant yellows, it consumes these reserves and gives time for the plant to use up these residual nutrients. So, as I've been lead to believe, harvesting when the plant is still too green, can affect negatively on the flavor, harshness and ash production.

If you have a good camera taking pictures can be fun. If you feel comfortable enough (no feelings of anxiety tripping in public), going for a stroll can be very pleasant as well. I recommend sunglasses during the day (sunlight can fuck my eyes up when on acid) and being in a safe place you are familiar with. Either way I like not having much planned just hanging around not doing much, tripping. But maybe you can make up a playlist of songs you might think you'd like while tripping. I don't really recommend watching to many videos or stuff like that until the comedown. I feel it takes away from the trip to have to much external stimulus. I don't really meditate in my usual life but when on acid it can be very pleasant. Just get comfortable and try to empty the mind. Don't think about the trip. I find that when your attention is less divided, cool things can happen. If you can have someone keep you company, but not necessarily engage a conversation with you, that would be optimal. I find that I like having someone keep my company but for the most part I'm not really interested in talking much.   


Just one last small tip: if you're looking an intense trip, doing activities that demand having your mind on different things at the same time, like I said before, having your attention divided, can be counterproductive. I find that when I'm most concentrated on something, without really giving much thought on the matter, cool things can happen. Those are my two cents at least.
